description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle Database data source to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including database connectivity, schema compatibility, photo storage, and authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC data source with Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Use the PostgreSQL JDBC driver and dialect, update datasource configuration to connect to the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint, and use Managed Identity for authentication instead of plaintext credentials. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea.
